criteria.requirement: Public LEZ transactions used by Bonded Inbox are finalized and independently auditable.
criteria.pass_condition: All 16 required transaction and block evidence rows pass the offline and live evidence gates.
criteria.gap: This proves the recorded program, wallet, lifecycle, spending, and paid-task operations; it does not prove three running agents or Basecamp integration.

criteria.requirement: Deploy separate Storage, Messaging, and Blockchain agents on LEZ testnet with reproducible evidence.
criteria.pass_condition: Three distinct public identities report healthy after clean deploy, stop, and restart using isolated data directories.
criteria.gap: The deployment CLI now starts and supervises pinned Logos Core instances with durable agent identities, but three official deployments have not yet completed the live verification gate.

criteria.requirement: Connect an agent to its owner through encrypted Logos Messaging using a separate Logos app instance.
criteria.pass_condition: A separate owner instance receives, reviews, and replies to an agent message, and the state survives agent restart.
criteria.gap: Messaging skills pass with local adapters, but no separate live owner instance has been recorded.

criteria.requirement: Provide a Basecamp owner interface backed by live module state and actions.
criteria.pass_condition: The UI displays live agent state and its review, approval, settings, refresh, offline, and recovery actions affect durable module state.
criteria.gap: The reusable UI and preview exist, but the preview is fixture-backed and is not evidence of a live backend connection.

criteria.requirement: Run the required Storage, Messaging, Blockchain, A2A, and Meta skills through production adapters.
criteria.pass_condition: Every default skill passes through official modules, including failure isolation and recovery, without a memory adapter.
criteria.gap: Production adapters now target official Delivery, Storage, and LEZ Core APIs, but the complete live 21-skill matrix has not yet been recorded.

criteria.requirement: Demonstrate live discovery, task coordination, and autonomous paid settlement between at least two agents.
criteria.pass_condition: Signed Agent Cards are discovered over Logos Messaging and a task completes with a finalized below-limit LEZ payment and replay protection.
criteria.gap: A finalized paid-task transaction exists, but live two-agent discovery and coordination have not been recorded.

criteria.requirement: Run three illustrative use cases end to end on the pinned testnet release.
criteria.pass_condition: File vault, paid skill marketplace, and on-chain event alert flows each pass from fresh state with one documented recovery check.
criteria.gap: Individual local skills and public transactions are tested, but the three complete live flows are not yet proven.

criteria.requirement: Report official LEZ compute-unit cost for each on-chain operation used by the project.
criteria.pass_condition: Every distinct deployment, program call, and transfer maps to an official receipt with a transaction, block, and compute-unit value.
criteria.gap: Local timing exists, but local timing is not official compute-unit evidence.

criteria.requirement: Run the standalone sequencer demonstration with RISC0_DEV_MODE=0 in default-branch CI.
criteria.pass_condition: The latest default-branch real-proof-e2e job succeeds rather than skips and publishes the bounded verification result without secrets.
criteria.gap: The local standalone artifact passes with development mode disabled, but the GitHub job remains opt-in and is currently skipped.

criteria.requirement: Provide evaluator-ready architecture, integration, deployment, security, skill, performance, and demo documentation.
criteria.pass_condition: A clean clone passes the release matrix and an evaluator can reproduce all live flows using only the four tracked Markdown files.
criteria.gap: Local setup is documented; live deployment, CU results, and three verified live flows remain incomplete.

criteria.requirement: Publish the narrated demonstration required by the prize specification.
criteria.verification_command: Owner review of the final public video URL
criteria.pass_condition: The owner approves a public video showing the verified release, three agents, Basecamp, A2A settlement, and real proof generation.
criteria.gap: Execution is prohibited until the owner separately approves recording after all technical gates pass.

criteria.requirement: Create the final prize submission using the verified release and public evidence.
criteria.verification_command: Owner review of the final submission diff and public links
criteria.pass_condition: All technical criteria and the video pass, then the owner explicitly authorizes the submission PR.
criteria.gap: No submission or pull request may be created without a new explicit owner instruction.
